description: This PHP class defines a model for time formats within the OrangeHRM system, implementing serialization for API responses. It encapsulates a time format identifier and provides a method to convert its data into an array representation suitable for API output.

classes.name: TimeFormatModel
classes.description: A model representing different time formats for the OrangeHRM API. It includes a constructor to initialize the format and a method to serialize the object into an associative array for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TimeFormatModel with a specific format identifier.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the TimeFormatModel into an array suitable for API serialization, mapping format ID to a string representation of the time format.
